name: acceptance-gate
description: Acceptance gate for AI-generated features: turns a request into an acceptance contract with Given/When/Then criteria, generates evals across four executor types, verifies them with fresh-context subagents and enforces evidence-backed verdicts with deterministic hooks, so a human decides only at a few real gates. v2.39.0 — release notes, and the full history of earlier versions that used to live here, are in CHANGELOG.md.
